items.text: Little optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined this week, expectation he sits.
items.why: Sources: not much optimism after DNP practices.
items.implication: Eagles WR targets consolidate elsewhere; Nacua return compounds for Rams matchup.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining Eagles pass-catchers

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on IR with hamstring injury; will miss at least 4 games. Corroborated by Rapoport.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3; coach confirmed significant, no surgery but multi-week.
items.implication: Kamara and Miller absorb lead role in committee; Etienne stash only.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries/targets for remaining Saints RBs

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles. Rapoport notes slated to play; full practice progress reported.
items.why: McVay confirmation after limited then progressing practices.
items.implication: Major upgrade for Rams offense and Nacua fantasy restart as WR1.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren as top-10 play TNF: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds/game. Full workhorse.
items.why: Elite usage short week; matchup favorable; Dowdle OUT again.

items.text: Ravens Lamar Jackson (back) and Zay Flowers (hamstring) upgraded to full participants Thursday.
items.why: Practice upgrades after limited Wednesday; minor issues.
items.implication: Both locked in as QB1/WR1 plays; Flowers snap share should rise.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes for Flowers; Jackson dual-threat intact

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed out for season, neck surgery/IR. Confirmed via LaFleur and Schefter reports.
items.why: Neck injury from Week 2 requires surgery; not career-threatening per coach.
items.implication: GB WR committee; Watson/Golden elevated long-term.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Christian Watson and others

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35%+ target share/104 ypg career with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194). NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Penix return unlocks volume; strong historical and recent usage.

items.text: Steelers rule out RB Rico Dowdle (and Porter Jr.) for TNF vs Browns; Ramsey questionable.
items.why: Toe injury; ruled out for Thursday.
items.implication: Confirms Warren full workload; Berry LOVE aligns.

items.text: ETR fresh ROS rankings: Kenneth Walker #3 overall notable. Also Parker Washington 22, Saquon 30, Matthew Golden 40. Trade calc prefers JT side of Flowers+Montgomery deal.
items.why: Updated post-Week 3 data; Walker elevated significantly.
items.implication: Buy Walker; hold/trade for JT preferred.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane torn ACL in Week 3, season-ending; placed on IR. Corroborated by Rapoport.
items.why: Torn ACL confirmed post-Week 3 vs Chiefs.
items.implication: MIA backfield to Gordon/Wright; major waiver priority shift.
items.opportunity: Lead role for Ollie Gordon and backups

items.text: Seahawks designate RB Zach Charbonnet to return to practice.
items.implication: Potential committee shift for SEA RBs soon; monitor activation.
items.opportunity: Possible snap share return impacting Walker/Price

items.text: HATE Justin Herbert @ SEA (pressure/low total), Omarion Hampton @ SEA (low snaps/targets/YPC allowed), Kyle Pitts @ NO (16% share/34 ypg career w/ Penix, TE37 util).
items.why: Tough matchups + poor recent usage/efficiency profiles.
items.opportunity: Hampton snaps/routes declining; Pitts low RZ/aDOT

items.text: HATE Emeka Egbuka vs GB (new QB, low RZ, low team total); Xavier Worthy @ LV (shrinking share as Rice rises, low aDOT, tough matchup).
items.opportunity: Worthy target share declining; Egbuka limited RZ

items.text: Kyle Pitts underperformed opportunity badly: only 6 targets through 3 games, none inside 10, low aDOT. Chart of worst results vs opportunity.
items.why: Raw target/aDOT/RZ data shows inefficiency relative to snaps.
items.implication: Fade/sit; matches Berry hate. Buy Leone for rebound candidates elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Low targets despite opportunity; no RZ
items.conflict: Conflicts with any high ranking based on name only
